scope: Five additional vendored text files read whole and Git-object verified. Syntax parsing only; no threads, subprocesses, registry access, web server or GUI launched.

python3_syntax.message: Missing parentheses in call to 'print'. Did you mean print(...)?

findings: kthread header carries LGPL2.1-or-later, unlike root MIT. No code copied; preserve per-file license provenance.
KThread kill flag is checked on Python line tracing; blocking native calls are not bounded cancellation. __run cleanup lacks finally if target raises. Demo uses undefined xrange on Python3.
macshim launches argv0 with32 suffix and an environment containing only one variable; child return code is not propagated. Read only.
homedirectory has Python2 print syntax, rejected by Python3 parser; Windows fallback imports _winreg rather than winreg.
String size formatter has finite unit list and no upper-bound guard; formatting helpers do not establish memory accounting correctness.
Vendored compat imports top-level pympler bottle modules; actual module resolution can differ from repository location.
